question: Which of the native parity reading and the supplied quantum measurements recovers the full four-setting distributions?
forbidden_inputs: No answer labels or distant settings enter local readouts. No outcome-dependent selection. No fitting quantum settings or changing the signs between comparisons.
primary_observable: All eight output probabilities per setting, full scored rows matched, and total variation for the best uniform-average local model.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Keep the same four ordinary words and erase coherence, or replace the quarter-turned flip by an unturned flip.
first_executable_signal: Even parity on the ordinary setting and the three mixed settings computed from one preparation and one fixed pair of questions.
resource_budget: One bounded CPU calculation over 64 potential-answer lists and 4096 one-bit readout choices, below a minute and 256 MiB.
stop_rule: Reconcile all complete scored tables, the four unscored inputs, the ordinary local bound and the finite parity-equation closure witness.
decision_or_followup_rule: Stop if the conditional match reproduces the known measurement law and the ordinary reading has a general obstruction. A new native instrument would be a different question.
nonclaims: No new GHZ prediction, derivation of the Born rule, or physical spacetime inference.
